question.text: A client's ONLY equity LTCG in FY is Rs. 2 lakh (held 18 months). Post-Jul 2024 LTCG tax payable:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the post-July-2024 Section 112A regime, LTCG on listed equity above Rs. 1.25 lakh per FY is taxed at 12.5%. With total equity LTCG of Rs. 2,00,000 in the year, the taxable portion is Rs. 2,00,000 − Rs. 1,25,000 = Rs. 75,000. Tax = 12.5% of Rs. 75,000 = Rs. 9,375. The Trap: Rs. 25,000 ignores the Rs. 1.25 lakh exemption and taxes the whole gain at 12.5%; Rs. 12,500 applies a 10% pre-budget rate to Rs. 1,25,000; 'Zero' assumes the entire Rs. 2 lakh is exempt, which is only true up to Rs. 1.25 lakh. Note: The NISM-Series-XXI-B workbook (pp. 185-190 and 192) supports the capital-gains characterisation and the holding-period classification but does not provide the 12.5% rate or the Rs. 1.25 lakh exemption that drive this calculation. The arithmetic above is based on the post-July-2024 Income Tax Act position rather than a workbook citation.
